key_impacts: Fenadesal Sur: 30 houses destroyed and more than 100 damaged
Fenadesal Sur: about 300 residents evacuated to safety
Bridges ripped away and homes obliterated along the Acelhuate River
Verapaz: major landslide; emergency WASH response deployed
evidence_snippets: A torrential rainstorm hit central El Salvador in November 2009; 198 people were killed.
Losses were serious—30 houses destroyed and more than 100 damaged—but the 300 people made it to safety.
Heavy rains triggered a major landslide in the town of Verapaz.
